# package storagetest

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/server/storage/storagetest"
```

Package storagetest is a test suite for implementations of storage.Store.

A VTN relies on its store for more than keeping objects: for the rules that have to be decided together with a write (unique names, references that lead somewhere, what may not be deleted), for the order of a search, and for returning what it was given. Run checks all of it, so that a store on a database of your own behaves as the ones of this module do:

	func TestMyStore(t *testing.T) {
		storagetest.Run(t, storagetest.Config{
			New: func(t *testing.T) storage.Store { return newMyStore(t) },
		})
	}

The stores of this module pass it, and so do the SQLite and PostgreSQL stores in examples/storage.

## Functions

### func Run

```go
func Run(t *testing.T, cfg Config)
```

Run runs the suite.

## Types

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	// New returns an empty store. It is called once per test of the suite,
	// and closes what it opens with t.Cleanup. Required.
	New func(t *testing.T) storage.Store
	// Reopen, when set, closes a store and returns one that holds what the
	// first held, as after a restart: the suite then checks that
	// everything is still there. Leave it nil for a store that does not
	// outlive its process.
	Reopen func(t *testing.T, s storage.Store) storage.Store
}
```

Config says how to make the store under test.
